program.section_heading: César E. Chávez Leadership Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to have a greater appreciation for local cultural heritage sites related to the leadership of César Chávez and the California farm worker movement.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to engage with local historical landmark sites, cultural heritage organizations, and various stakeholder groups invested in the preservation of history and culture in the San Joaquin Valley.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to enhance historical thinking skills, find deeper connections between the past and present, and develop leadership capacity and encourage civic participation within their own communities.

notes: The catalog prints the codes without a space ('HISTB98NC', 'HISTB99NC'). They are recorded in the closed-list form, HIST B98NC and HIST B99NC.

Hours are taken from 'Core Courses-18 hours (Credits listed are in hours)'. Each course prints '9 - 0' and the block prints 'Total 18 - 0'. The trailing '- 0' appears to be a credit-unit display artifact, so 9 hours per course and 18 hours for the block were recorded.
total_units of 18 hours is the stated Core Courses total. That block is the only requirement printed for the certificate. Please verify this reading.
Each printed outcome begins with 'Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to'. The phrase is part of each numbered item, so it was kept verbatim.
